versions.changelog:
Initial release of the google-news skill — a clean, pay-per-call Google News API alternative.

- Provides JSON endpoints for keyword search, section/latest headlines, specific topic IDs, supported language/region codes, and redirect URL decoding
- No RSS scraping or undocumented internal endpoints required
- Simple HTTP GET with payment via x402 (USDC) or prepaid credits (Bearer API key)
- Supports media monitoring, news aggregation, and press mention alerts
- Includes full error handling and documentation for authentication and endpoint usage
